title: Identity Security Operations Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Security Engineer to join our Enterprise Privileged Access Management (ePAM) team. In this role, you will support, maintain, and enhance critical PAM services that protect privileged identities across global cloud and on-premises environments. 

 You will work within a DevSecOps-focused team responsible for designing secure access controls, automating security operations, onboarding customers to PAM services, and ensuring the reliability and security of identity platforms used across the organization. 

 This position offers significant exposure to enterprise security technologies, global business stakeholders, and modern cloud identity solutions.
